suitableFor: listing/index pages with a filterable set of items
category-tagged card grids (destinations, adventures, products by type)
pages needing client-side tab filtering derived from item tags
notSuitableFor: simple non-interactive card grids (use the base cards block)
content that swaps entire panels rather than filtering one item set (use tabs)

notes: New interactive block. Combines a filter tab bar (categories derived from card category tags, plus an 'All' default) with a WKND-styled destination card grid. Card sub-structure mirrors the local 'cards' block (image + linked title + description). Multi-category cards supported (a card may match more than one tab).
